name: Body Mass Index Clinical Classification
description: BMI = weight(kg)/height(m)² classified per WHO: 18.5-24.9 normal, 25-29.9 overweight, ≥30 obese. Obesity multiplies metabolic, cardiovascular, and renal risk axioms.
semantic_fingerprint: BMI body mass index obesity weight height anthropometric WHO classification

name: PSA Prostate Screening Boundary
description: PSA must be <4.0 ng/mL for age-adjusted screening. PSA velocity and free/total ratio provide additional diagnostic resolution.
semantic_fingerprint: PSA prostate cancer oncological screening tumor marker

name: Diagnostic Sensitivity and Specificity Floor
description: Diagnostic tests must meet minimum sensitivity/specificity thresholds. Sensitivity ≥90% for screening; specificity ≥95% for confirmatory tests.
semantic_fingerprint: sensitivity specificity diagnostic accuracy ROC AUC PPV NPV

name: Medication Dosage Therapeutic Window
description: Drug concentrations must remain within therapeutic index. Narrow therapeutic index drugs require TDM.
semantic_fingerprint: medication dosage therapeutic window drug concentration TDM pharmacology

name: Adverse Event Traceability (Pharmacovigilance)
description: All serious adverse events (SAEs) must be traceable to intervention, timeline, and severity per ICH E2A/E2B.
semantic_fingerprint: adverse event SAE pharmacovigilance MedWatch ICH traceability

name: Dose-Response Gradient
description: Validates the presence of a monotonic dose-response relationship between an exposure magnitude and an observed clinical outcome. A consistent gradient (higher dose → stronger effect) strengthens causal inference and reduces the likelihood of spurious association.
semantic_fingerprint: dose response gradient monotonic exposure magnitude effect strength biological gradient

evidence_schema.gradient_coefficient: regression slope of dose vs response

name: Stem Cell Viability Gate (Trypan Blue / Flow)
description: Post-separation stem cell viability must be ≥90% (Trypan Blue exclusion or Annexin-V/7-AAD flow). Below threshold indicates apoptosis or necrosis from processing stress.
semantic_fingerprint: stem cell viability trypan blue flow cytometry annexin 7-AAD apoptosis necrosis CD34 hematopoietic
xai_narrator_hint: Stem cell viability below 90% indicates separation damage or sample aging — process parameters must be re-evaluated.

name: CD34+ Hematopoietic Stem Cell Enrichment Gate
description: CD34+ cell fraction in processed product must be ≥0.5% of total mononuclear cells for hematopoietic stem cell therapy eligibility.
semantic_fingerprint: CD34 hematopoietic stem cell HSC enrichment bone marrow transplant mobilization FACS flow cytometry
xai_narrator_hint: CD34+ percentage below 0.5% renders the product ineligible for hematopoietic transplant — consider G-CSF mobilization re-evaluation.

name: Colony Forming Unit (CFU) Potency Assay Gate
description: Stem cell product potency measured by CFU-GM assay must yield ≥10 colonies per 1×10⁴ cells plated. Sub-threshold potency indicates senescent or damaged progenitors.
semantic_fingerprint: CFU colony forming unit potency progenitor stem cell GM erythroid burst BFU methylcellulose assay
xai_narrator_hint: CFU-GM below 10 colonies/10⁴ cells indicates compromised progenitor potency — likely due to extended processing time or cryopreservation damage.

name: Objective Response Rate Gate (ORR - Immunotherapy)
description: Immunotherapy treatment must achieve ORR ≥ 20% (RECIST 1.1 partial + complete response) to be classified as clinically effective. Below threshold triggers treatment re-evaluation.
semantic_fingerprint: immunotherapy ORR objective response rate RECIST PD-1 PD-L1 checkpoint inhibitor cancer treatment efficacy
xai_narrator_hint: Immunotherapy ORR below 20% requires evaluating PD-L1 expression and Tumor Mutational Burden (TMB) as predictive efficacy biomarkers.

name: Immune-Related Adverse Event Safety Gate (irAE — Grade ≥3)
description: Grade ≥3 immune-related adverse events (irAE) per CTCAE v5.0 require mandatory immunotherapy hold. Incidence >15% triggers treatment protocol review.
semantic_fingerprint: irAE immune related adverse event CTCAE toxicity grade checkpoint immunotherapy colitis pneumonitis hepatitis endocrinopathy
xai_narrator_hint: Grade≥3 irAE requires immediate immunotherapy hold and high-dose corticosteroid — document organ system affected and CTCAE version.

name: PD-L1 Expression Threshold Gate (TPS/CPS)
description: PD-L1 Tumour Proportion Score (TPS) ≥1% or Combined Positive Score (CPS) ≥10 is required for PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor eligibility per FDA guidance.
semantic_fingerprint: PD-L1 TPS CPS tumour proportion score combined positive score checkpoint inhibitor biomarker IHC 22C3 28-8
xai_narrator_hint: PD-L1 TPS<1% and CPS<10 indicates patient is unlikely to benefit from PD-1/PD-L1 monotherapy — consider TMB or MSI-H as alternative biomarkers.

name: Cytokine Release Syndrome Severity Gate (CRS — CAR-T)
description: CRS grading per ASTCT 2019 consensus: Grade ≥3 (requiring vasopressors or ICU) mandates tocilizumab intervention. Applies to CAR-T and bispecific antibody therapies.
semantic_fingerprint: CRS cytokine release syndrome CAR-T cell therapy tocilizumab ASTCT grading fever hypotension hypoxia IL-6
xai_narrator_hint: CRS Grade≥3 in CAR-T therapy requires immediate tocilizumab 8mg/kg IV — check IL-6, ferritin, and CRP trend for cytokine storm trajectory.

name: Tumour Mutational Burden Gate (TMB)
description: TMB ≥10 mut/Mb (Foundation Medicine / MSK-IMPACT threshold) classifies tumour as TMB-High, conferring immunotherapy eligibility per FDA pan-tumour approval.
semantic_fingerprint: TMB tumour mutational burden mutations per megabase somatic mutation WES NGS MSK Foundation immunotherapy biomarker
xai_narrator_hint: TMB≥10 mut/Mb qualifies patient for pembrolizumab under FDA pan-tumour indication — confirm with MSI-H/dMMR co-testing.

name: DNA Double-Strand Break Index (γH2AX Gate)
description: γH2AX foci count per cell ≥5 indicates significant DNA double-strand break (DSB) load from radiation, chemotherapy, or oxidative stress. Used in stem cell quality control and treatment genotoxicity monitoring.
semantic_fingerprint: gamma H2AX DNA double strand break DSB genotoxicity radiation damage comet assay foci repair checkpoint ATM ATR
xai_narrator_hint: γH2AX>5 foci/cell indicates significant genotoxic stress — assess radiation dose, ROS levels, and ATM/ATR checkpoint activation status.

name: DNA Methylation Aberration Gate (Global Hypomethylation)
description: Global DNA methylation level (LINE-1 surrogate) below 60% indicates genome-wide hypomethylation, associated with genomic instability, transposon activation, and cancer epigenetic reprogramming.
semantic_fingerprint: DNA methylation LINE-1 hypomethylation epigenetics CpG island methylator CIMP cancer epigenome bisulfite pyrosequencing
xai_narrator_hint: LINE-1 methylation below 60% signals global epigenetic destabilisation — correlate with DNMT3A/TET2 mutation status and CIMP phenotype.

name: Chromosomal Instability Index (CIN — Copy Number Variation)
description: Chromosomal instability measured by fraction of genome altered (FGA) ≥20% indicates high CIN tumour, associated with poor prognosis and potential benefit from PARP inhibitors or immune checkpoint therapy.
semantic_fingerprint: chromosomal instability CIN copy number variation CNV FGA aneuploidy TP53 BRCA PARP inhibitor LOH
xai_narrator_hint: FGA≥20% indicates CIN-High tumour — test HRD score and LOH for PARP inhibitor eligibility; TP53 co-mutation frequently drives CIN escalation.

name: CRISPR On-Target Efficiency Score (Doench Rule Gate)
description: On-target score S ≥ 0.6 (Doench 2016 Rule Set 2) and off-target specificity ratio ≥ 10:1 are mandatory before clinical CRISPR gene editing. Below threshold requires redesign.
semantic_fingerprint: Doench score<0.6 or specificity<10:1 mandates guide RNA redesign — use Cas-OFFinder to enumerate off-target sites before IND filing.
xai_narrator_hint: Doench score<0.6 or specificity<10:1 mandates guide RNA redesign — use Cas-OFFinder to enumerate off-target sites before IND filing.
